instructions.instruction: Right the fallen cola can on the lounge table. Pick up and stow the first crumpled paper in the right hand, then pick up the second in the left. Carry both once to the bin beside the north lounge sideboard; release and withdraw the right hand before disposing of the second paper with the left hand.
instructions.instruction_zh: 扶正候客厅茶几上横倒的可乐罐；右手捡起第一团废纸并收拢，左手捡起第二团废纸，一次搬运到候客厅北侧边柜角落垃圾桶，右手先投放并撤开，再用左手投放。
